stem.text: The diagram shows the results of an experiment using leaves with the same surface area from two different species of plant. Each leaf was left on a balance in daylight in a closed room and its mass recorded at 1 hour intervals.

stem.alt: Graph of mass of leaf against time in hours from 0 to 6, with curves labelled leaf 1 and leaf 2.

stem.text: Which features of leaf 2 could explain these results?

items: more stomata per unit area of leaf
